name: ams OSRAM
old_description: Since 1906, the OSRAM brand has stood for continuous progress through light. On its 120th anniversary, it looks back on a unique history of innovation — and, as part of ams OSRAM, looks ahead to the world of Digital Photonics.
about:
ams OSRAM traces its roots to the OSRAM brand, established in 1906 in Germany. Today the company is headquartered in Premstaetten/Graz, Austria, with a co-headquarters in Munich, Germany, and a significant U.S. presence in Novi, Michigan. The business operates as a publicly traded global corporation with approximately 18,500 employees worldwide.

The company designs and manufactures semiconductor-based light emitters, optical sensors, CMOS integrated circuits, and related software, along with traditional lighting technologies for automotive and specialty applications. Its product portfolio includes VCSELs, infrared LEDs, UV-C LEDs, time-of-flight sensors, LiDAR lasers, and LED driver ICs, produced through global manufacturing capabilities and protected by a portfolio of around 12,000 patents.

ams OSRAM serves the automotive, industrial, medical, consumer electronics, mobile and wearables, lighting, and computing sectors. In automotive, its SYNIOS P2222 LEDs set a new standard for signaling, while its OSIRE E3030 RGB LEDs enable advanced interior lighting. In consumer health, Korean baby-care brand UPANG adopts the company's UV-C LED technology for bottle sterilization. The firm also supplies optical interconnects for AI data centers and LiDAR solutions for autonomous vehicles.

The company positions itself as a "Photonics Powerhouse," differentiating through its combination of light emission, detection, and intelligence — what it calls Digital Photonics. Its mission emphasizes pioneering lighting and sensing technologies that make the world safer, smarter, and more sustainable, backed by a culture of innovation, trust, and speed.

about:
Pan Pacific Plastics Mfg Inc was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Hayward, California. The company is independently owned and operated by a woman and is certified by the National Minority Supplier Development Council (NMSDC). It emphasizes family values among its employees and has built a reputation over four decades in the packaging industry.

The company manufactures and imports a full line of packaging bags made from paper and plastic. At its Hayward facility, Pan Pacific performs plastic extrusion, printing, and converting in an expanded manufacturing plant. It also maintains manufacturing partnerships across Asia to provide additional paper and plastic product capacity. Domestic production offers low minimums — as little as 100 pounds of plastic extrusion — with lead times of approximately four to six weeks; import lead times run ten to twelve weeks.

Pan Pacific serves a broad range of industries including grocery, retail, promotional, industrial, agricultural, food service, airline, travel, and hospitality. Its customer base includes Fortune 500 companies as well as individual homes and businesses worldwide. Product lines cover tamper-evident, retail, food service, industrial, and eco-friendly bags.

The company states its mission is to provide quality service and products at competitive prices while actively creating innovative packaging ideas. Differentiators cited include price protection programs that guarantee pricing and inventory for up to a full calendar year, an in-house graphic art department for artwork proofs and cleanup, and quality control inspections at both factory and warehouse levels. Responsiveness and customer support are described as staples of its business model.

name: trueCABLE
old_description: From bulk Ethernet and fiber cable to terminations and tools, trueCABLE delivers professional-grade products designed for seamless installs and rock-solid performance. Every item is tested to exceed industry standards — so your network runs faster, longer, and more reliably.
about:
Based in Kansas City, Missouri, trueCABLE operates as a supplier of branded networking infrastructure products. The company focuses on delivering Ethernet and fiber optic cabling solutions directly to installers and end users.

The product range spans bulk Ethernet cable in Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6A categories, all constructed with solid bare-copper conductors. The catalog also includes fiber optic patch cables in OS2, OM3, and OM4 configurations, a line of termination connectors (RJ45 pass-through, keystone jacks, toolless variants), patch panels in shielded and unshielded versions, and a suite of installation tools backed by a lifetime warranty. Orders placed by 3 p.m. Central Time ship the same day.

Customers include data-center operators, commercial office builders, industrial facilities, residential integrators, and low-voltage contractors. The company also serves satellite and coax installations through its bulk coax cable line. Technical guidance is provided through an online resource library called The Cable Academy.

trueCABLE differentiates itself by testing every product to exceed UL, ANSI/TIA, and RoHS standards, offering a 30-day money-back guarantee, and providing a Forever Warranty on its branded tools. The company emphasizes a system approach where cable, connectors, and tools are validated to work together in the field.

about:
10 Men Metal Fabrication operates from Omaha, Nebraska, where it was established in 2019 by owner and president Jaco Germishuys. The company began with a vision to serve as a one-stop shop for architectural sheet metal and custom fabrication, regardless of project size or complexity.

The shop specializes in architectural sheet metal fabrication for metal roofing systems, providing services such as shearing, folding, welding, perforating, and metal finishing. Its fully equipped metal shop produces standing seam panels, custom trim, vented ridge caps, column covers, cornice metal, gutters, downspouts, conductor heads, scuppers, and specialty items like copper and zinc countertops and backsplashes. The team brings 38 years of combined industry experience and has completed over 500 projects.

Customers include contractors, architects, homeowners, and DIY enthusiasts primarily across the Midwest. The company works with professionals in the construction industry as well as residential clients seeking custom architectural metal components.

The business differentiates itself through its ANSI ES-1 certification for metal roofing components, UL-certified flashings and copings, and a commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and customer service backed by decades of experience. It also offers expert consultation on material selection and design.

about:
21st Century Plastics Corporation operates from Potterville, Michigan, where it was founded in 1997. The business transitioned to 100% employee ownership in 2010 under an Employee Stock Ownership Plan.

The shop runs 15 plastic injection molding machines ranging from 55 to 1,500 tons, equipped with high-pressure injection, closed-loop process control, and automatic mold data storage. Two table-travel CNC vertical mills handle steel, aluminum, and plastic, while an Airwolf 3D Axiom printer produces fixtures and prototypes in over 40 materials. Additional capabilities include surface grinding, manual machining, fixture design, CAD/CAE engineering services, and a production monitoring system. Assembly services cover spin welding, painting, and offline assembly.

The company's website does not specify particular industry verticals or named customers.

21st Century Plastics emphasizes a personal-touch approach to custom molding, backed by a quality management system certified to ISO standards since 1997 and updated to ISO 9001:2015. Employee ownership is cited as a driver of accountability and customer service.

name: 406 Processing & Taxidermy
old_description: 406 Processing & Taxidermy is a whole animal butchery that provides year around services for farmers and ranchers including processing wild game during hunting season. 406 is a small-town, locally owned business.
about:
Based in Great Falls, Montana, 406 Processing & Taxidermy operates as a locally owned whole-animal butchery. The business is owned and operated by award-winning taxidermist Dylan Lencioni, an avid hunter and fisherman who founded the company to serve the farmers, ranchers, and hunters of central Montana.

The facility provides year-round processing services for both wild game and livestock. During hunting season, the shop handles deer, elk, and antelope, while its livestock program offers on-ranch slaughtering—teams travel to the ranch to harvest animals and transport them back for cutting, wrapping, and specialty meat production. The taxidermy side produces European skull mounts using a beetle-cleaning method that preserves delicate bone structure, as well as full taxidermy mounts crafted by award-winning taxidermist Brad Lencioni.

Customers include Montana ranchers who need USDA-inspected or custom slaughter for cattle and other livestock, and hunters seeking reliable processing for their harvest. The company emphasizes that every carcass is tracked so clients receive meat from their own animal, a guarantee highlighted on its about page.

Differentiators cited by the company include the guarantee of meat identity, the convenience of on-ranch slaughter, the beetle-based European mount process that avoids bone shrinkage, and the reputation of its taxidermists for trophy-quality work. Lencioni frames the business as a family-oriented operation built on trust and personal pride in each step from field to table.

about:
83 Woodworks LLC is a custom cabinetry and millwork shop based in Saco, Maine. Founded in 2020 by Troy Nadeau, the business grew from a simple flower box he built for his wife; a passerby's offer to buy it sparked the venture. Nadeau's woodworking roots trace back to his teenage years working with his father and a vocational program in architectural design and CAD.

The shop designs, fabricates, and installs custom cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, home offices, closets, garage storage, and built-ins, as well as commercial millwork such as reception desks and fixtures. Work flows from concept and CAD drafting through CNC machining and hand assembly to on-site installation. The company operates as a single shop serving Southern Maine; headcount and facility size are not publicly disclosed.

Primary customers are homeowners throughout Southern Maine seeking tailored storage and architectural woodwork. The shop also serves commercial clients needing custom millwork for retail, office, and hospitality spaces. Projects range from single-room built-ins to full kitchen remodels and commercial fixture packages.

Nadeau started the company to combine thoughtful design with purposeful function, emphasizing refined craftsmanship and personal collaboration from first idea to finished space. The firm highlights clear communication, fixed payment terms (30/30/40), and financing options as part of its client experience.
